text: In 1985 the Crown in Canada charged Zündel, the publisher of Richard Verrall's Did Six Million Really Die?, with spreading false news. His conviction was overturned when the case reached the Supreme Court of Canada.
meta_description: Did Six Million Really Die?: in 1985 the Crown charged its publisher Zündel with spreading false news; the conviction was overturned.
changes: Author added to the first sentence; charge, then outcome. Prosecution of the publisher is not called a book ban.
